---
title: What is the hub, traderswift-1?
description: The chain at the centre of TraderSwift, and its validator rotation.
order: 3
---

The hub is the chain at the centre of TraderSwift.

It holds identities, the charters of each subnet, the providers who run them, and the anchors subnets post to it. It holds no token and no balances.

![The hub and its subnets](../assets/since-lockbox/hub-and-subnets.svg)

The hub went live on 14 November; its first block was signed at 14:13 UTC.

On 17 November we rotated its validators onto new machines. The result is four validators with equal power, and block 40,631 was signed by all four.

![traderswift-1 heights recorded this week](../assets/since-lockbox/hub_heights.svg)

The next step is a handover of the hub's admin, scheduled at a set height.

On 18 November the chain was at 52,814 and waiting for it.
